---
name: Bug report
about: Report a reproducible problem with this distribution
---

## What happened?

Describe the expected and actual behavior, and how to reproduce it.

## Environment

Include the release/package version, pfSense/FreeBSD version, ABI, CPU and whether per-IP collection is enabled. For flow problems, describe the capture interface's role and relevant health counters.

## Evidence

Include only relevant, redacted logs or configuration excerpts. Remove all keys, account identifiers, private hostnames and network details. Do not attach packet captures or router backups. Report vulnerabilities through SECURITY.md instead.
